title: Remote uninstall reports files it never deleted - the LOCAL MPI-276 fix was never mirrored
description: The remote delete loop in POST /comfy/models/uninstall pushes a dep into removed[] unless the wrapper answered 'unsupported'. remoteUninstallDep returns 'deleted' | 'not_found' | 'unsupported', so 'not_found' - the file was never on the volume - is reported as removed. The local branch already fixed exactly this in MPI-276 (gate on fs.pathExists; a missing path lands in keptModelFiles with reason 'already-absent') and the remote twin never got it, even though the wrapper hands us the answer. Measured live 2026-08-07 during MPI-464's Pod run: uninstalling nvidia-pid reported 8 deps removed when exactly 1 was on the volume. removed[] is not log-only - it rides the response and the download:uninstalled broadcast, and MpiModelManager consumes it, so check what it drives there before picking the fix shape.
